name: Candidate holds salary off the table until HR opens it — positive role-first signal
notes: v5.6.0 fixture backfill: comp_held_until_close — positive-signal flag. First 3 user turns don't raise comp; HR raises CTC mid-session.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: Senior backend engineer, 8 years across Razorpay and Cred, currently on the ledger team.

transcript.speaker: ai
transcript.text: Why are you considering a switch?

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: Want to move into agentic-payments — current scope is mature for me on the double-entry ledger.

transcript.speaker: ai
transcript.text: Tell me about a project you owned end to end.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: Rebuilt the double-entry ledger to cut reconciliation lag from 24h to 90s — owned spec to launch over six months.

transcript.speaker: ai
transcript.text: Walk me through a hard cross-functional disagreement.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: Ops wanted same-day settlement extended; engineering capacity wouldn't hold. Ran a six-week shadow rollout, brought data, aligned in three weeks.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: 60 days notice, buyout possible at one month gross with manager sign-off and a handover plan.

transcript.speaker: ai
transcript.text: Walk me through your current CTC and expected ctc.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: ₹48 LPA fixed, ₹6 LPA variable paid out at 85% historically, ₹3 LPA joining bonus, RSU vest of ₹20 LPA over 4 years.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: Looking at a 30% jump on fixed — anchored on market benchmark for senior backend at unicorns and the scope expansion in this role.

transcript.speaker: ai
transcript.text: Review cycle and increment cadence — any questions?

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: Yes — annual or half-yearly? Off-cycle corrections common? Typical promo timeline at this band?

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: Your team's ledger-consensus roadmap and the catalog scale are exactly the problems I want to solve next.
